On 7/19/07, Yifang Hu <h...@wehi.edu.au> wrote:
>
> Hi Henrik,
>
> Thanks. Now, it only took about 30 min.
>
> express.exon <- getChipEffectSet(plm.exon) seems fine too.
>
> But,there's error when doing
>
> theta.exon <-extractMatrix(express.exon)
>
> Error in matrix(NA, nrow = max(uUnitSizes), ncol = length(unitNames)) :
> matrix: too many elements specified
>
> Is it because some units are not fit (NA)?

No. This is due to how extractMatrix() is implemented. Try to exclude
the large units when extracting the data as a matrix.

/H
